correctness.rationale: Proof derives the normalized Wigner function using Weyl/Bopp identities and exact trace (gamma+t)/(2t), and checks Gaussian integration to 1. Elliptic polar change gives the exact positive Bessel integral. With s=t exp(2r), z=t exp(-2r), the absolute relative error of N/[t^3 G(s)] from 1 is at most 12(exp(-4r)+t exp(-2r)+t^2), using an explicitly lower-bounded positive angular integral and exact comparison of Gaussian-damping and endpoint changes. Endpoints and fixed-r limit are justified by dominated convergence; a separate disk-integral representation and pointwise strict decrease prove the sharp envelope. Independent numerical quadratures test seven parameter pairs and endpoint laws; no finite test is used for an infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The relevant nonclassicality quantity remains nonzero at every finite thermal temperature; the full negative-volume asymptotic is needed to quantify its decay. The theorem identifies the logarithmic squeezing/thermal-occupation crossover, a universal positive scaling function for every joint parameter path, and exact sharp asymptotic coefficients.
